entries.purpose: Reject H0-H4 unless all mandatory positive-process contract fields are evidence-backed.
Verify exact continuation-state conservation when no dry process is qualified, without relabelling persistence as physical inertness.
Verify zero continuation mass remains exact zero with no hidden creation.
Verify no-process state persistence is exactly timestep-partition invariant because no physical process operator is applied.
Verify exact split-run restoration from the persistent continuation owner without hidden process memory.
Reject reconstruction of continuation physical state from a mass-balance residual.

negative_controls: Promoting M_cont_after=M_cont_before to a physical zero-rate law must fail.
Reusing FRVO unchanged for continuation mass must fail.
Reusing soil nitrification or soil NH4 sorption unchanged must fail.
Inventing any dry-process parameter without provenance must fail.
Selecting a dry-process receiver not already scientifically qualified must fail.
Adding a rewetting receiver, threshold or kinetics to SQ06 must fail.
Allowing the mass observer to own or reconstruct continuation state must fail.
